bio: My name is Chu Quang Huy — a Full-Stack Developer and AI Engineer based in Hanoi, Vietnam. I build production web systems with .NET and React.js, and ship AI features end-to-end: Computer Vision (eKYC / face attendance), Document OCR with table & figure extraction for government investment (Đầu tư công) workflows, and Speech-to-Text with ASR fine-tuning for automated meeting transcription and summarization. I work across SQL (MySQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB), apply DDD, SOLID, and distributed-system principles, and deliver in Agile Scrum teams.
